source_row.stem: A newborn born to a mother who used opioids during pregnancy is monitored for neonatal abstinence syndrome. This condition presents with:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"No symptoms of any kind, despite this syndrome being characterized by a recognizable cluster of withdrawal signs","B":"Only respiratory symptoms, rather than the broader neurologic and gastrointestinal signs typically seen","C":"Withdrawal symptoms such as tremors, high-pitched crying, poor feeding, and irritability","D":"Symptoms considered identical to those of a normal, unexposed newborn"}}
source_row.rationale: Neonatal abstinence syndrome presents with withdrawal symptoms including tremors, high-pitched crying, poor feeding, irritability, and other signs, requiring monitoring and supportive care, sometimes pharmacologic treatment.
source_row.source_name: AAP — Neonatal Abstinence Syndrome Clinical Guidance
